subject: StellarPay evaluation kickoff & next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: StellarPay discovery follow-up + proposed eval kickoff

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing, integrating Redwood embeddings for semantic search across transaction notes.
- Key constraints: PII handling (token redaction), on-prem option for audit logs, sub-200ms median latency for short responses.
- Success metrics you mentioned: 15% reduction in average handle time, 95% precision on intent classification, and acceptable cost per 1k tokens.

Next steps we discussed: schedule the evaluation kickoff to run a 4-week trial with an initial prompt set and success criteria, then do a technical deep dive with our solutions engineer.

Proposed windows for the kickoff call (30–45 min):
- Wed May 19, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed May 19, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu May 20, 09:00–09:45 PT

I've attached a draft evaluation plan (StellarPay-eval-plan-Connor-v1.xlsx) that outlines the trial cadence, data checklist, and preliminary prompt set. Can you confirm which slot works for Raj/your team? If none of these are good, propose 2 alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — happy to adjust the plan based on any legal or compliance constraints you flagged.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
\

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarpay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@stellarpay.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarPay discovery follow-up + proposed eval kickoff

Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap and the plan. Wed May 19 at 14:00 PT works for both me and Raj.

A couple quick notes before the kickoff:
- We will need a short section on data handling during the trial (what you store, KMS options).
- Our security team asked for a high-level SOC 2 evidence list up front — can you send that prior to the call?

If you can include Marissa on the technical deep dive invite that would be great.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, StellarPay
alicia.gomez@stellarpay.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
\

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@stellarpay.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarPay discovery follow-up + proposed eval kickoff

Perfect — locking in Wed May 19, 14:00–14:45 PT for the evaluation kickoff. Calendar invite sent.

Attached: Redwood-eval-success-criteria.pdf (one-page summary) and the draft eval plan you already have. Quick agenda for kickoff (30–45 min):
1) Introductions & objectives (5 min)
2) Trial scope and timeline (10 min)
3) Success criteria & prompt set overview (10 min)
4) Data handling & compliance checklist (7 min)
5) Next steps: technical deep dive + SOW/contract cadence (5 min)

Action items before the call:
- I will share SOC 2 evidence summary and a brief note on our KMS options by EOD today.
- Alicia / Raj: please share any sample transcripts or redaction requirements so Marissa can prepare targeted examples.

Marissa — would you be available after the kickoff for a 60-min technical deep dive next week (options: Thu May 27 or Mon May 31)? We want to cover embedding pipelines, latency tuning, and prompt engineering with your team.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
\Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarpay.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@stellarpay.com>
Date: Thu, 19 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarPay discovery follow-up + proposed eval kickoff

Thanks for looping me in. Confirming I'm on the kickoff today at 14:00 PT. Post-kickoff I can do the deep dive on Thu May 27 11:00–12:00 PT or Mon May 31 09:00–10:00 PT — either works on my end.

For the deep dive, please send a few representative transcripts and sample prompt categories (summaries, routing, intent classification). I'll prepare:
- Latency tuning checklist for our runtime (sequence length buckets, batch sizing)
- Embedding pipeline recommendations and sample code snippets
- A short eval harness to measure the 95% precision target you mentioned

See you on the call.
\—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128
